title: Mini-case: Patagonia-style outdoor brand
text: An outdoor clothing company founded by climbers in 1973 has always repaired used gear, donated 1 % of sales to environmental groups and avoided discount campaigns. A new CEO proposes a Black Friday sale and a fast-fashion line for teenagers to boost growth.

title: Mini-case: a bank that sells phones
text: A digital bank launches its own smartphone with built-in banking and a “financial wellbeing” assistant. Analysts covering banks do not know how to value the hardware business; tech reviewers compare it with Apple and Samsung and find it average.

title: Mini-case: three business schools
text: A top-3 business school launches a degree in “Business & Fine Arts”. A mid-ranked school and a recently founded school consider similar programmes.
